title: Orca: The World is in Your Mind
task: Unified world state prediction from multimodal signals
key_results: Orca learns a unified world latent space from 125K hours of video and 160M event annotations; outperforms similar-sized baselines on text generation, image prediction, and action generation downstream tasks
comments: Novel next-state-prediction framing is compelling, but evaluation focuses primarily on frozen-backbone transfer rather than truly end-to-end world understanding.

hypotheses.hypothesis: A unified world latent space learned from both dense video transitions and sparse language-annotated events supports diverse downstream tasks
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; frozen backbone with lightweight task-specific decoders achieves strong performance across modalities

title: Dockerless: Environment-Free Program Verifier for Coding Agents
task: Environment-free program patch verification for coding agents
key_results: Dockerless outperforms strongest open-source verifier by 14.3 AUC points; enables fully environment-free post-training reaching 62.0% resolve rate on SWE-bench Verified
comments: Eliminates expensive Docker environment setup costs but relies on agentic repository exploration which may not generalize to all patch types.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Patches can be verified without execution by gathering evidence through agentic repository exploration
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; outperforms execution-based verifiers and enables efficient post-training pipelines

title: DOPD: Dual On-policy Distillation
task: Advantage-aware dual on-policy distillation for LLMs and VLMs
key_results: DOPD consistently outperforms Vanilla OPD; demonstrates superior performance on LLM and VLM settings with improved stability, robustness, and continual learning
comments: Addresses privilege illusion effectively but introduces additional routing complexity; generalization to out-of-distribution tasks validated but margins not specified quantitatively.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Privilege illusion arises when privileged information conflates capability gaps with information asymmetry; dynamic routing based on advantage gaps mitigates this
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; advantage-aware routing outperforms uniform supervision strategies

title: BlockPilot: Instance-Adaptive Policy Learning for Diffusion-based Speculative Decoding
task: Instance-adaptive block size selection for diffusion speculative decoding
key_results: BlockPilot achieves acceptance length of 5.92 and 4.20x speedup on Qwen3-4B (T=1) with minimal overhead; optimal block size exhibits clear local structure enabling low-dimensional policy learning
comments: Plug-and-play approach is practical but assumes training/inference distribution alignment; speedup gains are specific to tested model and temperature regime.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Optimal block size varies per sample and exhibits structure around training block size, enabling lightweight instance-adaptive prediction
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; consistent efficiency improvements across models with low prediction overhead

title: Scenes as Objects, Not Primitives: Instance-Structured 3D Tokenization from Unposed Views
task: Instance-structured 3D scene decomposition from unposed multi-view images
key_results: Feed-forward framework surpasses per-scene optimization baselines on class-agnostic instance segmentation while remaining competitive on novel view synthesis; enables direct object-level manipulation without 3D annotations
comments: Two-level factorization (instance tokens + anchor tokens) is elegant but requires joint reconstruction-segmentation supervision; open-vocabulary retrieval complexity scales with instances which may be limiting for large scenes.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Decoupling object identity from local appearance via two-level token factorization enables effective instance-level scene understanding and editing
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; achieves strong instance segmentation and enables manipulation as native operation

title: GEAR: Guided End-to-End AutoRegression for Image Synthesis
task: Joint end-to-end training of VQ tokenizer and autoregressive generator with representation alignment
key_results: GEAR speeds up ImageNet gFID convergence by up to 10x vs LlamaGen-REPA; learns better patch-level and spatially-coherent features; generalizes across quantizers
comments: Dual readout mechanism elegantly sidesteps non-differentiability but shifts alignment burden to AR model; feature shift toward AR semantics may not be optimal for all downstream tasks.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Joint end-to-end training with representation-alignment guidance enables tokenizer to optimize for AR predictability while maintaining reconstruction quality
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; significantly faster convergence and better feature quality vs decoupled training

title: Multi-Block Diffusion Language Models
task: Multi-block parallel decoding for diffusion language models
key_results: MBD-LLaDA2-Mini increases Tokens Per Forward pass from 3.47 to 6.19 and improves accuracy from 79.95% to 81.03%; MBD-LLaDA2-Mini-DMax reaches 9.34 TPF with only 1.02% accuracy drop
comments: Multi-block teacher forcing effectively bridges train-inference gap but scalability to larger blocks or more heterogeneous noise patterns unclear; wall-clock acceleration depends on hardware utilization.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Training on bounded noise-groups with randomized noise-schedulers matches multi-block inference better than single-block teacher forcing
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; achieves higher accuracy and TPF than prior BD-LM approaches

title: Evolution Fine-Tuning: Learning to Discover Across 371 Optimization Tasks
task: Cross-task generalization for evolutionary optimization via fine-tuning on search trajectories
key_results: EFT achieves 10.22% average improvement across 22 held-out tasks; matches SOTA on circle-packing tasks and outperforms on Erdős minimum-overlap problem when paired with test-time RL
comments: Finch Collection dataset (156K trajectories, 371 tasks) is valuable but limited to 10 domains; whether capability truly transfers or models overfit domain patterns remains somewhat unclear.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Fine-tuning on evolutionary search trajectories teaches LLMs generalizable solution-evolution strategies transferable across diverse optimization tasks
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; consistent cross-task improvements with held-out task validation

title: SkillHone: A Harness for Continual Agent Skill Evolution Through Persistent Decision History
task: Continual agent skill evolution with persistent decision history
key_results: SkillHone outperforms deep-research baselines by 15.8 points on GAIA, 3.2 points on WebWalkerQA-EN; improves accuracy by average 18.8 points across seven internal tool-mediated scenarios
comments: Persistent decision history is valuable but may accumulate noise over many refinement rounds; role-separated subagents add complexity and potential failure modes.

model_io.model: SkillHone (skill evolution harness with history tracking)

hypotheses.hypothesis: Recording structured histories of diagnoses, revisions, and outcomes enables cross-session skill refinement without rediscovering past rationale
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; significantly outperforms prior skill-evolution methods and commercial agent

title: MemLearner: Learning to Query Context memory for Video World Models
task: Learning-based adaptive context querying for video world models
key_results: MemLearner significantly outperforms prior video world models in scene consistency and memory, particularly under challenging occlusion and dynamic scenarios
comments: Query token mechanism is intuitive but evaluation metrics and quantitative improvements not fully specified; generalization to novel scene types with extreme occlusions unclear.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Learning-based context querying via query tokens better handles occlusions and dynamic objects than rule-based frame retrieval
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; improved consistency on multi-dataset training with annotated and unannotated videos

title: Managing Procedural Memory in LLM Agents: Control, Adaptation, and Evaluation
task: Evaluating procedural memory skill transfer across tasks, roles, and models
key_results: Single refinement round improves performance by 3.7-6.7 points; skills from diverse multi-model traces achieve 73.1% cross-model test accuracy; some skills generalize broadly while others specialize to roles
comments: AFTER benchmark (382 enterprise tasks) is realistic but scope limited to six roles; findings suggest procedural memory effectiveness is task and role dependent, complicating deployment.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Procedural memory enables consistent performance gains; skill generalization varies by task type and depends on multi-model training diversity
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; significant practical gains for industrial workflows with evidence of both broad and role-specific specialization

title: RedVox: Safety and Fairness Gaps in Speech Models Across Languages
task: Multilingual safety and fairness evaluation for speech models
key_results: RedVox benchmark covers five languages; only 8% of speech model releases document multilingual safety analysis; vulnerabilities worsen in non-English and under spoken input
comments: RedVox fills important gap in multilingual safety but is limited to five European languages; real-voice data collection raises unique privacy challenges not fully resolved.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Safety vulnerabilities persist in non-English speech models and are amplified by spoken input modality
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; multilingual disparities and modality-specific effects documented

title: DataEvolver: Self-Evolving Multi-Agent Data Construction for Text-Rich Image Generation
task: Self-evolving multi-agent data construction for text-rich image generation
key_results: DataEvolver improves OCR-F1 by 85.3% on TextScenesHQ and 35.3% on LongTextBench vs fixed-dataset baseline at 0.75M scale; benefits transfer to Show-o2
comments: Feedback-driven construction policy is innovative but computational cost of multi-agent loop and quality of generated synthetic data for coverage not fully analyzed.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Rejected samples provide actionable feedback for improving data construction; multi-agent framework can evolve coverage over rounds
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; consistent OCR accuracy improvements and benefits generalize to different downstream generators

title: Little Brains, Big Feats: Exploring Compact Language Models
task: Benchmarking small language models in retrieval-augmented generation systems
key_results: RAG systems with small LMs execute on-device without GPU within reasonable time; comprehensive evaluation on open-source and proprietary datasets covering diverse subjects
comments: Useful practical study but lacks quantitative performance metrics and comparative analysis with larger models; reproducibility limited to GitHub repository links.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Small LMs can effectively generate answers in RAG systems when executed on-device without GPU
hypotheses.result: Partially confirmed; feasibility demonstrated but detailed performance analysis missing

title: Reinforcement Learning with Metacognitive Feedback Elicits Faithful Uncertainty Expression in LLMs
task: Metacognitive feedback-based reinforcement learning for faithful uncertainty calibration
key_results: RLMF achieves state-of-the-art faithful calibration across diverse tasks; surpasses standard RL by up to 63%; metacognitive data selection outperforms naive active learning
comments: Metacognitive approach is well-motivated but two-stage decoupled pipeline adds complexity; generalization to frontier LLMs beyond tested models unclear.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Reinforcement learning with metacognitive feedback improves both calibration quality and general capability; metacognitive performance is effective RL signal
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; consistent improvements on faithful calibration and outperformance of standard RL approaches

title: PolyFlow: Continuous Topology Embedding Flow Matching for Artist-style Mesh Generation
task: Parallel mesh generation via continuous topology embedding and flow matching
key_results: PolyFlow surpasses autoregressive baselines in Chamfer and Hausdorff Distance; supports explicit mesh resolution control; achieves rapid generation via ODE solver
comments: Topology embedder design is clever but recovery of discrete adjacency via spacetime thresholding may introduce artifacts; artist-quality evaluation limited to Toys4K benchmark.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Continuous per-vertex embeddings can faithfully represent discrete mesh topology; flow-matching enables efficient parallel vertex state denoising
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; superior speed and quality vs autoregressive baselines with explicit resolution control

title: Xiaomi-GUI-0 Technical Report
task: Native multimodal GUI agent for real-device mobile task automation
key_results: Xiaomi-GUI-0 achieves 72.0% success on RealMobile and 78.9% on AndroidWorld; substantially improves execution stability and abnormal-state recognition vs benchmarks
comments: Real-device-dominant hybrid infrastructure is practical but creates data collection bias; error-driven flywheel effectiveness and reproducibility on other devices unclear.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Real-device training and evaluation enables detection of abnormal states and improves execution stability vs simulated/offline benchmarks
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; strong performance with improved robustness on real-world distribution shifts

title: Unlocking the Visual Record of Materials Science: A Large-Scale Multimodal Dataset from Scientific Literature
task: Large-scale multimodal dataset extraction from materials science literature
key_results: MatSciFig contains 391,606 panel-level image-text pairs from 180,571 figures; dual-encoder retrieval achieves 4.4x R@1 improvement over zero-shot CLIP; MaterialScope detector achieves mAP_50 of 0.9227
comments: MatMMExtract pipeline and annotations are valuable resources but annotation generation via LLM introduces hallucinations (4.8% rate); domain specificity may limit broader applicability.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Panel-level decomposition and LLM-guided annotation enable high-quality vision-language dataset for materials science; retrieval performance improves substantially
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; MatSciFig demonstrates utility for domain-specific vision-language learning

title: QVal: Cheaply Evaluating Dense Supervision Signals for Long-Horizon LLM Agents
task: Training-free evaluation of dense supervision signals for long-horizon LLM agents
key_results: QVal benchmarks 21 dense supervision methods across 1.2K experiments; simple prompting baselines outperform recent methods; performance clusters strongly by family across models and environments
comments: Q-alignment metric is intuitive but assumes reference policy quality; training-free evaluation may miss interactions with specific training algorithms.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Q-alignment is a reliable proxy for downstream training performance; simple prompting baselines are more effective than recent specialized methods
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; consistent findings across diverse environments and model sizes

title: BrainJanus: A Unified Model for Understanding and Generation across Brain, Vision, and Language
task: Unified brain-vision-language model for neural encoding and decoding
key_results: BrainJanus achieves superior performance across diverse benchmarks; exhibits zero-shot generalization; preserves interpretable biological topography as unified model
comments: Integration of brain, vision, language in single framework is novel but evaluation focuses on task performance rather than biological interpretability; any-to-any generation capability somewhat preliminary.

model_io.model: BrainJanus (unified brain tokenizer + all-in-one AR architecture)

hypotheses.hypothesis: Unified multimodal framework with shared tokenization better models brain-vision-language correspondence than separate unimodal approaches
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; superior performance with preserved biological structure and zero-shot generalization

title: AVTok: 1D Unified Tokenization for Holistic Audio-Video Generation
task: Unified one-dimensional tokenization for holistic audio-video generation
key_results: AVTok excels in audio-video reconstruction and downstream generation tasks; hierarchical training strategy resolves information imbalance; unified codebook reduces computational overhead
comments: 1D unified representation is elegant but audio-visual synchronization constraints and quality tradeoffs at different compression levels not fully quantified.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Hierarchical training resolves heterogeneous information imbalance; unified 1D tokenization supports efficient joint audio-video generation
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; successful reconstruction and downstream generation with reduced computational cost

title: PhotoQuilt: Training-Free Arbitrary-Resolution Photomosaics via Bootstrapped Tiled Denoising
task: Training-free high-resolution photomosaic generation via bootstrapped tiled denoising
key_results: PhotoQuilt generates photomosaics at arbitrary resolution with both global coherence and local detail; bootstrapped tiled denoising avoids quadratic attention cost; outperforms baselines on structure and realism
comments: Procedure elegantly balances global and local constraints but quantitative metrics (FID, structural similarity) not provided for rigorous comparison.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Bootstrapped low-to-high resolution pipeline with fixed-tile denoising preserves both global structure and local tile quality at arbitrary resolution
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; qualitative improvements over baselines with scalability to large canvases

title: LUMOS: A Semantic Operating-System Layer for Accessibility-Grounded AI Agents
task: Semantic operating-system layer for accessibility-grounded AI agent interaction
key_results: LUMOS converts accessibility metadata into machine-readable semantic blueprints; reduces token costs and visual ambiguity vs screenshot-based approaches; enables live semantic pointer grounding
comments: Accessibility layer design is compelling but limited to operating systems with semantic metadata; not all UI frameworks expose rich semantic information.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Machine-readable semantic UI abstractions reduce token costs and ambiguity while maintaining action expressiveness vs visual approaches
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; LUMOS enables efficient accessibility-grounded agent interaction

title: MuSViT: A Foundation Vision Model for Sheet Music Representation
task: Foundation vision model for sheet music representation
key_results: MuSViT (ViT pre-trained on 9.7M IMSLP pages) outperforms general-purpose encoders on sheet music tasks; linear probing shows systematic advantage; encodes symbolic structure directly in embeddings
comments: Domain-specific foundation model is well-motivated and curriculum learning on synthetic-to-real is effective; but downstream task improvements under fine-tuning are sometimes incremental.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Domain-specific pre-training on sheet music captures symbolic notation structure better than general vision models; curriculum learning improves representation quality
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; superior linear-probing performance and direct encoding of musical structure

title: TerraDiT-Ω: Unified Spatial Control for Satellite Image Synthesis with Any Geospatial Primitive
task: Unified spatial control for satellite image synthesis from geospatial primitives
key_results: TerraDiT-Ω supports control from any geospatial primitive (polygons, polylines, boxes, points); geometry-aware local attention outperforms dense and sparse baselines; improves downstream segmentation/detection tasks
comments: Unified geospatial control is practical for GeoAI workflows but evaluation limited to specific downstream tasks; generalization to new geographies or satellite sensors unclear.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Geometry-aware local attention enables flexible spatial control from varied geospatial primitives while maintaining compatibility with GeoAI workflows
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; consistent outperformance over single-control-type baselines with utility for synthetic data augmentation

title: FlexiSLM: A Dynamic and Controllable Frame Rate Spoken Language Model
task: Dynamic and controllable frame rate spoken language model
key_results: FlexiSLM outperforms fixed-frame-rate models at high quality operating points; achieves 6.25 Hz with roughly halved inference time vs 12.5 Hz while maintaining speech quality; down to 4.0 Hz with degradation
comments: Frame rate flexibility is valuable for deployment but quality-speed tradeoff curves not fully characterized; applicability to non-English languages and diverse acoustic conditions unclear.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Dynamic frame rate representations exploiting non-uniform information density enable controllable quality-speed tradeoffs in spoken language models
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; significant inference acceleration with quality preservation at moderate compression rates

title: Molecular basis for depsipeptide HDAC inhibitor combinatorial biosynthesis
task: Determine structural basis for PKS-NRPS docking interaction enabling combinatorial biosynthesis of hybrid depsipeptide HDAC inhibitors
key_results: Unusual subunit docking modality identified enabling interaction between conserved Zn2+-binding pharmacophore and variable peptide-based cap; validated via crosstalk assays, mutagenesis, and carbene footprinting
comments: The use of multiple orthogonal techniques (AlphaFold, carbene footprinting) strengthens the docking hypothesis, though atomic-resolution structural data would provide definitive validation.

model_io.model: AlphaFold protein structure prediction and carbene footprinting

hypotheses.hypothesis: Unusual subunit docking modality enables interaction between conserved pharmacophore and variable cap biosynthetic modules
hypotheses.result: Confirmed: crosstalk assays and mutagenesis demonstrate functional interaction; carbene footprinting maps contact sites

hypotheses.hypothesis: PKS-NRPS fusion proteins represent a conserved mechanism in hybrid polyketide-peptide biosynthesis evolution
hypotheses.result: Supported: gene proximity search identifies putative Vpb4-like proteins suggesting broader protein family

title: Structural basis for independent pore function of Vpb4 from Bacillus thuringiensis
task: Determine pore structure of single-component Vpb4 toxin and mechanistic differences from two-component binary toxins
key_results: 2.2 Å cryo-EM structure reveals missing molecular bottleneck and neutrally charged β-barrel; Vpb4Aa2 shows greater ion flux than PA archetypal member
comments: The structural insight elegantly explains functional divergence within the toxin family, though the electrophysiology comparison remains preliminary and would benefit from comprehensive kinetic characterization.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Single-component Vpb4 proteins form independent pores with altered structural features compared to two-component toxins
hypotheses.result: Confirmed: missing bottleneck and neutral charge enable higher ion conductivity

title: A carboxylate switch point controls long-range energy transduction in respiratory Complex I
task: Elucidate the long-range proton-coupled electron transfer coupling mechanism in Complex I via carboxylate-mediated charge transfer
key_results: D79NuoA identified as conserved carboxylate switch point mediating proton transfer; disease-associated mutation reduces PCET activity to 20% of wild-type
comments: The integration of cryo-EM, mutagenesis, and multiscale simulations provides robust mechanistic insight, though the link between the kinetic gate and the >300 Å energy transduction pathway could be more explicitly mapped.

hypotheses.hypothesis: D79NuoA acts as a kinetic gate coupling redox chemistry to proton pumping in the E-channel
hypotheses.result: Confirmed: mutation abolishes coupling and reduces PCET activity; conserved across species

hypotheses.hypothesis: Neurodegenerative disease mutations disrupt the carboxylate switch mechanism
hypotheses.result: Confirmed: patient mutations perturb charge transfer and energy transduction

title: Exercise-stimulated primary cilia on preosteoclasts promote periosteal-bone formation
task: Identify the primary cilia-mediated mechanism by which preosteoclasts sense mechanical stimulation to promote periosteal-bone formation during exercise
key_results: Mechanical stimulation activates Dvl2 via primary cilia on preosteoclasts, suppressing cathepsin K and preserving periostin; cathepsin K inhibition overcomes cilia deficiency to restore bone formation
comments: The study elegantly connects mechanotransduction via primary cilia to bone remodeling through periostin preservation, providing a foundation for therapeutic targeting of cortical bone strength in aging and disease.

model_io.model: Conditional knockout mice (Cx3cr1-Cre or Ctsk-Cre with Ift88loxP/loxP and/or Kif3aloxP/loxP); mechanical stimulation assay

hypotheses.hypothesis: Primary cilia on preosteoclasts are required for exercise-induced periosteal-bone formation
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; cilia-deficient mice showed decreased periosteal-bone formation and cortical-bone size upon exercise

hypotheses.hypothesis: Mechanical stimulation activates Dvl2 via primary cilia to suppress cathepsin K
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; cilia-dependent Dvl2 activation prevents cathepsin K production

hypotheses.hypothesis: Cathepsin K inhibition overcomes primary cilia deficiency
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; cathepsin K inhibition restored bone formation in cilia-deficient exercised mice

title: FOXQ1 activates GLT8D2 to enhance CCL2 N-glycosylation and promote prostate cancer bone metastasis
task: Elucidate how FOXQ1 activates GLT8D2 to enhance CCL2 N-glycosylation and promote PCa bone metastasis
key_results: FOXQ1 upregulated in bone metastatic PCa; directly activates GLT8D2 transcription; GLT8D2 enhances CCL2 N-glycosylation, recruiting macrophages and promoting osteoclast differentiation
comments: The study identifies a multi-level regulatory axis (FOXQ1→GLT8D2→CCL2 glycosylation) with potential therapeutic targets, though the structural basis for how N-glycosylation enhances CCL2 function remains unclear.

model_io.model: PCa cell lines; co-culture with macrophages and osteoclast precursors

hypotheses.hypothesis: FOXQ1 directly activates GLT8D2 transcription
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; FOXQ1 binds GLT8D2 promoter and increases transcription

hypotheses.hypothesis: GLT8D2-mediated CCL2 N-glycosylation promotes bone metastasis
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; GLT8D2 overexpression enhances CCL2 glycosylation and bone metastatic potential

title: Pin1 targets phosphorylated NCOA4 for K29/K48-linked ubiquitination to suppress ferritinophagy and ferroptosis in anaplastic thyroid cancer
task: Identify Pin1's role in suppressing ferroptosis via NCOA4 ubiquitination and ferritinophagy
key_results: Pin1 recognizes phospho-NCOA4 (Ser572 by CDK2) and promotes K29/K48-linked polyubiquitination; Pin1 inhibition enhances ferritinophagy and ferroptosis, reducing ATC growth 70-80% in vivo
comments: This work elegantly connects prolyl isomerase activity to ferroptosis suppression in cancer, with promising therapeutic implications, though the structural basis for Pin1-NCOA4 recognition awaits crystallographic validation.

model_io.model: ATC cell lines and xenograft models

hypotheses.hypothesis: Pin1-mediated NCOA4 ubiquitination suppresses ferritinophagy and ferroptosis
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; Pin1 inhibition stabilizes NCOA4, enhances ferritinophagy, and triggers ferroptosis

hypotheses.hypothesis: Pin1 inhibition reduces ATC progression in vivo
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; KPT-6566 treatment markedly restrained ATC growth in xenografts

title: The mechanism of 45S5 bioactive glass-mediated, cell-type-specific death of bone tumor cells
task: Identify the cell death mechanism by which 45S5 bioactive glass particles selectively kill bone tumor cells
key_results: BG induces ROS, Ca2+ elevation, MAP-kinase and AKT activation in tumor cells; ferroptosis is primary death mechanism (V-ATPase dependent, elevated Fe2+ and MDA); apoptosis, pyroptosis, and necroptosis excluded
comments: The study elegantly demonstrates selective ferroptotic death of tumor cells while sparing non-neoplastic cells, with mechanistic insights into lysosomal and iron metabolism; therapeutic potential hinges on tuning BG composition to balance tumor cytotoxicity and bone regeneration.

model_io.model: Bone tumor cell lines and non-neoplastic bone cells; in vitro cultures
outputs: Cell death (ferroptotic vs apoptotic vs pyroptotic)

hypotheses.hypothesis: BG-induced ferroptosis is the primary tumor-specific cell death mechanism
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; elevated Fe2+ and MDA, V-ATPase requirement, absence of caspase activation rule out apoptosis/pyroptosis/necroptosis

hypotheses.hypothesis: Non-neoplastic cells are refractory to BG-mediated ferroptosis despite ROS induction
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; tumor cells show Ca2+ elevation, kinase activation, and ferroptotic markers absent in non-neoplastic cells

title: Aluminium ammonium sulphate induces epithelial pyroptosis and eosinophilic inflammation under dysbiotic conditions: ameliorative effects of heparin
task: Determine whether AAS triggers epithelial pyroptosis under dysbiotic conditions and whether heparin ameliorates this effect
key_results: AAS induces caspase-1/11-GSDMD activation (ROS-dependent) and caspase-6/8-GSDME (ROS-independent), triggering pyroptosis and eosinophil infiltration; heparin suppresses these events and epithelial death
comments: The study reveals a previously unrecognized pro-inflammatory mechanism of a food additive under dysbiotic conditions, with interesting divergence between ROS-dependent and ROS-independent caspase activation pathways.

model_io.model: Mouse intestinal epithelial cells (IECs) in vivo and immortalized IEC lines

hypotheses.hypothesis: AAS promotes IEC pyroptosis under dysbiotic conditions via caspase-1/11-GSDMD pathway
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; AAS triggered GSDMD cleavage and pyroptosis dependent on mtROS and dysbiosis

hypotheses.hypothesis: Heparin suppresses AAS-induced pyroptosis and eosinophilic inflammation
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; heparin reduced caspase activation, IEC death, and eosinophil infiltration in vivo and in vitro

title: Two-pore channel-2 controls calmodulin-dependent STIM1 inactivation
task: Elucidate how TPC2-mediated lysosomal Ca2+ release regulates STIM1 inactivation and SOCE
key_results: TPC2 activation enforces rapid Ca2+-CaM-dependent inactivation of SOAR, preventing STIM1 cluster formation and SOCE; effects reversed by CaM inhibition or cytosolic Ca2+ chelation
comments: The paper elegantly demonstrates cross-talk between lysosomal and ER Ca2+ signaling through a calmodulin-dependent mechanism that was previously underappreciated.

model_io.model: Multiple mammalian cell lines (HEK293, CHO, RBL)

hypotheses.hypothesis: TPC2 activation via NAADP or TPC2-A1-N will suppress SOCE
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; both activators enhanced SCDI and prevented STIM1-mediated SOCE

hypotheses.hypothesis: Ca2+-CaM-dependent inactivation mediates TPC2 inhibition of SOCE
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; CaM inhibition and Ca2+ chelation prevented TPC2-mediated SOCE suppression

title: Double functionalized Sindbis E2 glycoprotein modifies Sindbis tropism favouring infection of α5β1⁺ glioblastoma cells
task: Engineer Sindbis virus E2 glycoprotein to selectively target and kill α5β1+ glioblastoma cells
key_results: Double-functionalized E2 protein retained transduction capability while enhancing selective killing of α5β1+ over α5β1- glioblastoma cells in culture; replication-competent virus reduced α5β1+ xenograft growth in vivo
comments: The work demonstrates proof-of-concept for integrin-targeted oncolytic viotherapy with preserved membrane fusion capability, though off-target toxicity and immunogenicity in immunocompetent hosts require further evaluation.

model_io.model: Glioblastoma cell lines and xenograft models; lentivector pseudotyping assay

hypotheses.hypothesis: Double functionalization of E2 allows selective targeting of α5β1+ cells while preserving fusion capability
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; modified E2 retained transduction and enhanced selective killing of α5β1+ cells

hypotheses.hypothesis: Replication-competent Sindbis with modified E2 reduces α5β1+ tumor growth in vivo
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; virus injected via tail vein reduced brain xenograft expansion

title: Presenilin-1 controls glycolysis and identity of pancreatic beta cells
task: Determine the role of presenilin-1 in beta cell glucose sensing and identity
key_results: PS1 knockdown causes glycolytic bottleneck at glyceraldehyde-3-phosphate dehydrogenase, reducing glucose responsiveness; PS1 required for beta cell identity preservation
comments: The study connects PS1's well-known Alzheimer's function to a novel metabolic role in beta cells, though the causative link between glycolysis defects and identity loss remains mechanistically incomplete.

model_io.model: Pancreatic beta cell lines and primary islets; AD mouse model

hypotheses.hypothesis: PS1 regulates sub-mitochondrial Ca2+ homeostasis to control glycolytic flux
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; PS1 knockdown impaired glucose-induced calcium signaling and glycolysis

hypotheses.hypothesis: PS1-dependent glycolysis is essential for beta cell identity
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; PS1 knockdown caused identity loss linked to glycolytic defect

title: Metabolic reprogramming in polyol pathway contributes to anti-inflammatory effect of glucosamine salts on synovial fibroblasts
task: Elucidate the anti-inflammatory mechanism of glucosamine via polyol pathway reprogramming and epigenetic silencing of COX-2
key_results: GlcN-HCl suppresses IL-1β-induced COX-2 and PGE2 via epigenetic silencing (reduced H3K27ac and H3K4me3 at COX-2 promoter); requires AKR1B1-mediated polyol pathway activation producing sorbitol
comments: The paper reveals an elegant metabolic-epigenetic axis linking glucosamine metabolism to inflammatory gene silencing, with clear structure-activity relationships (C-2 stereochemistry critical) and translational potential for rheumatoid arthritis.

hypotheses.hypothesis: GlcN-HCl suppresses COX-2 via epigenetic silencing rather than mRNA destabilization
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; reduced H3K27ac/H3K4me3 at COX-2 promoter; mRNA stability unchanged

hypotheses.hypothesis: Polyol pathway activation is required for GlcN-HCl anti-inflammatory effects
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; AKR1B1 inhibition abrogated COX-2 suppression and PGE2 reduction

hypotheses.hypothesis: C-2 stereochemistry is critical for anti-inflammatory activity
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; C-2 epimer (ManN-HCl) showed markedly diminished bioactivity compared to C-4 epimer

title: Ancestry-linked IL-10 signaling and macrophage activation modulate fibroblast responses to oxidative stress in a PEG-based microphysiological system
task: Dissect ancestry-linked differences in IL-10 signaling and macrophage activation that modulate fibroblast fibrotic responses
key_results: African ancestry: higher monocyte CCL4, lower OXER1, elevated serum IL-10; European ancestry: higher fibroblast α-SMA and p16; IL-10 is protective against fibroblast activation, especially in African ancestry cultures
comments: This microphysiological system elegantly demonstrates inter-individual immune variation influencing fibrosis risk, though the mechanistic link between ancestry-associated cytokine profiles and long-term fibrotic outcomes requires longitudinal validation.

model_io.model: PEG-based hydrogel microphysiological system with donor-matched fibroblasts, macrophages, and serum

hypotheses.hypothesis: Ancestry-associated differences in IL-10 signaling influence fibroblast activation
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; IL-10 inhibition increased α-SMA particularly in African ancestry cultures

hypotheses.hypothesis: IL-10 is protective against TGF-β1-mediated fibroblast activation in African ancestry cultures
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; elevated baseline IL-10 in African ancestry serum correlated with lower α-SMA expression

title: A deep learning framework for efficient pathology image analysis
task: Efficient pathology image analysis via selective tile analysis

key_results: Established direct correspondence between zeta function zeros and phase transitions at unique temperature; demonstrated polynomial-resource quantum algorithm for hypothesis probing
comments: Intriguing bridge between number theory and quantum dynamics, but physical relevance to solving RH remains unclear.

model_io.model: Quantum many-body engineered systems (two complementary variants)

hypotheses.hypothesis: RH zeros correspond to dynamical quantum phase transitions
hypotheses.result: Confirmed experimentally on quantum processor; polynomial quantum framework proposed

title: A smart contact lens with plasmonic nano-confinement nanowire array for non-invasive ocular blood oxygen saturation monitoring
task: Enable non-invasive ocular blood oxygen saturation monitoring via smart contact lens
key_results: Flexible plasmonic nano-confinement nanowire photodetector integrable into contact lens; in vivo demonstration of continuous ocular SpO₂ monitoring
comments: Promising wearable platform but translation to clinical validation and systematic performance metrics across patient populations needed.

inputs: PEDOT:PSS nanowire array with gold nanoparticles
outputs: contact lens signal via backend circuit

hypotheses.hypothesis: Synergistic nanowire confinement and LSPR enhance photoconversion efficiency for oxygen sensing
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; successful in vivo ocular SpO₂ monitoring demonstrated

title: A framework of partial error correction for intermediate-scale quantum computers
task: Allocate quantum resources between noisy and error-corrected qubits for intermediate-scale systems
key_results: Brick-layered circuits show slower decoherence with increasing fraction of error-corrected qubits; advantage manifests only above a qubit-coupling-dependent threshold
comments: Framework is practical for NISQ era but threshold dependence may limit applicability across different architectures.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Brick-layered circuits decohere slower than fully noisy circuits under partial error correction
hypotheses.result: Confirmed analytically and numerically; advantage appears above threshold qubit fraction

title: Electro–thermal benchmarking of low-order lithium-ion battery equivalent circuit models under constant-current and dynamic loading
task: Benchmark low-order lithium-ion battery equivalent circuit models under constant and dynamic loading
key_results: Hybrid electro-thermal 1RC model achieves 28±5 mV voltage RMSE, 1.2±0.3 °C surface temperature RMSE, 1.8±0.4% heat-generation consistency under WLTC profile
comments: Rigorous benchmarking with fixed thermal parameters; extrapolation to broader cell chemistries and aging scenarios remains open.

model_io.model: Three equivalent circuit model structures (Rint, 1RC, hybrid electro-thermal 1RC)

hypotheses.hypothesis: Increasing electrical model fidelity improves voltage tracking and heat consistency under dynamic conditions
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; hybrid 1RC substantially outperforms Rint model across WLTC profile

title: Nanometer scale imaging to develop quantitative descriptors of bipolar membrane junction structure
task: Characterize bipolar membrane junction nanostructure and water dissociation catalyst architecture
key_results: AFM imaging resolves nanometer-scale junction structure; quantified line edge roughness and catalyst layer thickness; electric field induces catalyst particle alignment during operation
comments: Workflow is adaptable but limited to specific junction architectures; computational modeling validation pending.

model_io.model: Bipolar membrane junction imaging and segmentation

hypotheses.hypothesis: Electric field during electrodialysis aligns catalyst particles
hypotheses.result: Supported by pre/post comparison; structural changes quantifiable via image analysis

title: Lightweight stateless transaction verification with outsourced witness updates for UTXO blockchains
task: Enable lightweight stateless transaction verification with outsourced witness updates for UTXO blockchains
key_results: LSTVS supports script-based authorization verification and reduces local witness update overhead; improved transaction verification rate vs. RSA accumulator schemes
comments: Addresses critical scalability concern but performance gains depend on witness outsourcing reliability.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Outsourced witness updates reduce local overhead for intermittently online nodes
hypotheses.result: Confirmed experimentally; improved verification rate and reduced UTXO-scale dependence

title: An agentic artificially intelligent X-ray scientist
task: Demonstrate autonomous X-ray sample alignment via large language model-driven agentic AI
key_results: AI agent successfully aligned sample and determined orientation matrix on real synchrotron beamline; correctly identified reference reflections and adapted to unexpected conditions
comments: Proof-of-concept for autonomous experimentation; generalization to other scattering techniques and facilities requires further validation.

model_io.model: LLM-driven agentic X-ray scientist with model context protocol

hypotheses.hypothesis: LLM-driven agent can autonomously perform X-ray sample alignment via iterative planning and observation interpretation
hypotheses.result: Confirmed on virtual and real beamline; demonstrated adaptive problem-solving under unexpected conditions

title: Systematic bottom-up coarse-graining of hydrated excess proton transport across scales
task: Develop multiscale coarse-grained model for hydrated excess proton transport via bottom-up approach
key_results: HUMID model recapitulates diffusion and hydronium correlation functions with three-order-of-magnitude computational speedup; systematic design principle for reactive internal states derived from quantum mechanics
comments: Elegant multiscale framework but validation against experimental proton conductivity data and coupling to mesoscale phenomena still required.

model_io.model: Hydronium Ultra-coarse-grained Model with Improved Dynamics (HUMID)

hypotheses.hypothesis: Internal states derived from quantum mechanics enable accurate CG representation of hydrated proton transport
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; three-order-of-magnitude speedup achieved with preserved accuracy
